messages:
Jess: Quick idea — before the big launch send, can we add a 2-question micro-survey inside the newsletter to split subscribers by intent? (evaluate vs trial). If we tag responses, we can route webinar invites and follow-ups differently.

Ben: I like it. 2 questions keeps it frictionless. Suggestion: 1) "Which best describes you?" (Evaluate / Trial / Just browsing) 2) "Would you join a short webinar?" (Yes / Maybe / No). Host on a tiny Typeform and link inline.

Priya: Sounds good. For routing: can we send invite A to Evaluate+Yes, invite B to Trial+Yes, and a short nurture to Maybe? Also want to A/B send window (Tue 10am vs Thu 2pm).

Alex: Subject-line ideas for A/B: 
- A: "New inference benchmarks + invite — quick RSVP"
- B: "See how we cut token costs in half — webinar inside"

Marta: Deliverability note — don't blast the whole list at once. Throttle by ISP and region. If we test windows, make sure each cohort respects warm-up rules (no >15% to gmail successive sends). Also include click-only segment for the Saturday re-send.

Ben: Implementation notes: we can add ?utm_campaign=launch_microseg and a hidden field in Typeform for original_send_ts. Use our mailer tag: `{{microseg_answer}}` to populate routing. Example minimal routing rule: 
```
if microseg_answer == "Evaluate" and webinar_rsvp == "Yes": schedule send -> /campaigns/webinar-eval
elif microseg_answer == "Trial" and webinar_rsvp == "Yes": schedule send -> /campaigns/webinar-trial
else: schedule -> /campaigns/launch-nurture-short
```

Jess: Great. Priya — can you own the mapping table for which webinar creative goes to which segment? Ben/Alex — can you own the Typeform + mailer tag wiring? Marta — can you confirm throttling rules and ISP windows?

Priya: I can own mapping. I'll draft creatives for Evaluate vs Trial (short vs technical). ETA: EOD Friday.

Alex: I'll prep subject lines + preview text variants. I'll wire up the UTM and the `{{microseg_answer}}` token in staging.

Ben: I'll implement the Typeform, hidden fields, and the webhook to push responses into the CRM. I'll also add a lightweight retention rule so non-responders get a 1-day follow-up.

Marta: I'll set throttling: 10k/hr for NA initial, hold 10% for later sends, and verify MX ramp for Gmail. Will post screenshots of the ISP schedule once set.

LaunchBot: Reminder: Campaign draft saved. Scheduled send window placeholder: 2026-04-07 10:00 UTC. Use `/launch confirm` to lock.

Jess: Small ask — can we include a single-line callout for the benchmark whitepaper in the same send (link to PDF)? Keep it subtle so CTR doesn't cannibalize the survey.

Priya: Yes — I'll include a 1-sentence blurb and a small CTA under the fold.

Alex: Quick A/B plan for tracking: measure open -> click -> micro-survey completion -> webinar RSVP. We'll use cohort tags to measure conversion to trial within 14 days.

Jess: Perfect. If everyone hits their ETAs, I'll lock campaign by Monday morning and we run the A/B send the following week. :rocket:

Ben: @Jess noted. I'll post the Typeform link when done.

Marta: Will confirm ISP ramp tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
